body.holes_note: expected as planned at graph commit 4f771bb8ade887b4b158d06b3da2d3437ba50fec: a hole restating an existing node is that node (expected_new false), the rest are new nodes numbered after the node's earlier holes; another decomposition of this node merging first renumbers them. A hole that restates a node under another branch of the target (expected_new false and the node not a hole child of this one) makes that node a lemma of this node, listed in its META.yaml and CONTEXT.json: its theorem is in this node's Context.lean, the assembly or a direct proof may use it once it is proved, and this node never waits on it; one proof of the lemma serves every branch that restated it
